# address matches too. Verdict "true" is something the kind is meant to find; anything else is a false
# prompt and its group names the root cause. Matches no rule decides count as "untriaged" (false).
# False verdicts name the pages they were checked on, so a real address or number on a new page
# shows up untriaged instead of being called a misread.
